judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated only at A=E in R^n and positive exponents: a>n>0 in S002 and s>0 in S003. Compactness and the routine metric/power facts recorded below have their required conditions. There are no E/M applications.

For n>0 the partition count and Euclidean diameter estimate give cost at most C n^(a/2) h^(a-n). At each fixed positive scale, admissibility holds for all sufficiently small h and the cost tends to zero, so every scale content and hence H^a(E) is zero. N001 and the order argument give D<=n even before finiteness is known. The singleton branch gives D=0. A finite subcover by radius-delta/2 balls gives finite s-cost for arbitrary s,delta>0. All clauses of N002 follow.
